Deterministic reference-clip recording QA on machines without a usable microphone; replays a WAV through the genuine visible recording flow. Reclassified 2026-07-22 from the retired hidden-hook list by explicit maintainer decision.

Audio QC tier T3 controlled generation (audit 2026-09-25 section 5.2, GEN-NOEOS): QWENVOICE_TALKER_EOS_SUPPRESSION_FRAMES=N holds back the talker's first sampled EOS for N codec frames (0-256; 0 is the sham), giving the class I entropy and EOS detectors positives with a certain effect. Production safety: the host resolves it through RuntimeDebugGate into each request's immutable sampling configuration (request-local, never process-global runtime state), so it needs the VOCELLO_INTERNAL_DIAGNOSTICS compile condition that distribution builds omit plus QWENVOICE_DEBUG=1; unset or out of range, no request carries a hold and the generate loop is the production loop. Each held take records the frames and the frame the hold opened at in its engine row, and runtime debug provenance names the key.

RF-14 blind A/B of four verified divergences from Qwen's reference implementation (docs/audits/2026-10-12-audio-qc-tooling-research.md section 3.1). Production samples from float32 logits (D3, maintainer decision 2026-10-13, adopted on reference grounds without listening): QWENVOICE_SAMPLER_FLOAT32=off reverts to the model's own precision for comparison. Production also filters the talker's EOS through top-k, top-p and min-p like any token (D2, adopted 2026-10-20 by the RF-18 follow-up screen's pre-registered rule): QWENVOICE_TALKER_FILTER_EOS=off re-inserts it after the filters, as before. Each other key set to on takes the reference behavior: QWENVOICE_FULL_TEXT_CONDITIONING (D1) gives streamed Custom and Design takes the full-text layout quality-first takes already use; QWENVOICE_CUSTOM_AUTO_LANGUAGE (D6) lets a Custom take with ambiguous language detection fall back to Auto instead of English. Production safety: read only through RuntimeDebugGate (an internal-diagnostics build plus QWENVOICE_DEBUG=1); D1-D3 resolve at the host into each request's immutable sampling configuration (referenceParity, encoded only when set) and D6 into the request's language hint, so no process-global state enters the runtime. Unset, every request takes the shipped path (D2 and D3 on, D1 and D6 off). Each armed take's generation row names its keys in runtime debug provenance (activeOverrideKeys), and a D6 take records its language hint; the engine's preparation diagnostics also carry reference_parity (D1-D3) and text_conditioning_mode.
